name: North-east of Tai Bwo Wannai
accessNote: Karamja jungle north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring DKP); reached via Tai Bwo Wannai teleport scroll or the Brimhaven boat. Two safespots exist and a dwarf multicannon can be used, but the bug lantern must stay equipped for the cannon to damage swarms. Bring antipoison for nearby aggressive, poisonous creatures; Tai Bwo Wannai Trio unlocks the Tribal Statue prayer recharge.
